name: All Document Reader
description: Your PDFs, documents, spreadsheets and presentations, together in one reading workflow.
intro: Open, read and organize supported documents on your Android phone. From reports for work to notes for class, keep the files you need within reach.

features.title: Read across formats
features.text: Open PDFs, Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, PowerPoint presentations and plain text files.

features.title: Find your documents
features.text: Locate supported files on your device through the file access you choose to grant.

features.title: Keep things organized
features.text: Bring finding, opening and organizing documents into a focused mobile workflow.

note: Complex formatting, encrypted documents and damaged files may affect how individual files open or display.

name: Quit Vape & Pouches
description: Keep your quit plan, daily logs and personal milestones in one place.
intro: A personal tracking app for adults working towards quitting vaping or nicotine pouches. Keep your plan, daily entries and reminders together on your phone.

features.title: Your plan, in one place
features.text: Record a quit date, step-down plan and daily limits, with a clear view of the information you enter.

features.title: Make each check-in count
features.text: Log daily use, view streaks and milestones, and see estimates based on your entries.

features.title: Build a daily routine
features.text: Use check-in reminders and a home-screen widget to stay connected with your personal progress.

note: For adults of legal age. This app provides personal tracking and general information. It does not provide medical advice or emergency care.
